articles.title: An Important Moment
articles.subtitle: 如何自然地展开一场演讲｜保留英文转写；音频为合成朗读。

lines.text: Good morning everyone!
lines.translation: 大家早上好！

lines.text: To be honest, I am a little nervous right now.
lines.translation: 说实话，我现在有点紧张。

lines.text: Not because I'm afraid to speak, but because I know how important this moment is.
lines.translation: 不是因为我不敢开口，而是因为我知道这一刻有多重要。

vocabulary.meaning: 说实话。用来自然引出自己的真实感受；honest 开头的 h 不发音。
就在此刻。这里强调的是当下的紧张，而非平时不擅长演讲。
不是因为……而是因为……。先排除听众容易想到的原因，再讲真正的原因。

paragraphs.text: Good morning everyone! To be honest, I am a little nervous right now. Not because I'm afraid to speak, but because I know how important this moment is.

lines.text: We all come from different backgrounds, different stories and different experiences.
lines.translation: 我们来自不同的背景，各自有不同的故事，也有不同的经历。

vocabulary.meaning: 成长背景、出身或过往经历。这里不是照片里的背景。
这里指一段亲身经历，可数；泛指积累的经验时通常不可数。

paragraphs.text: We all come from different backgrounds, different stories and different experiences.

lines.text: But today we're all here together in this place that shaped us, in this place that challenged us,
lines.translation: 但今天，我们都相聚在这里，在这个塑造过我们、也磨炼过我们的地方。

lines.text: in this place that sometimes made us feel lost and we didn't back down, we didn't give up.
lines.translation: 在这个有时也让我们感到迷茫的地方。可我们没有退缩，也没有放弃。

vocabulary.meaning: 塑造我们，指一段环境或经历影响了我们成为怎样的人。
感到迷茫、不知道下一步怎么办，不是字面上的迷路。
面对压力时退缩或让步；这里和 give up（放弃努力）并列，强调既没退缩，也没放弃。

paragraphs.text: But today we're all here together in this place that shaped us, in this place that challenged us, in this place that sometimes made us feel lost and we didn't back down, we didn't give up.

edits.explanation: 原文照录。书面稿通常用逗号隔开称呼；跟读时可在 morning 后稍停。

edits.before: in this place that shaped us, in this place that challenged us,
edits.after: in this place that shaped us, in this place that challenged us,
edits.explanation: 这句不是重复啰嗦，而是演讲排比。跟读时每个 in this place 前稍停，把重音放在 shaped 和 challenged；结尾把 didn't back down 与 didn't give up 分开说。

articles.voice: 美式女声 · SLT 合成朗读

articles.title: Changing in Front of Friends
articles.subtitle: 为什么在熟人面前改变更难｜保留用户整理的口语原文；音频为合成朗读。

lines.text: For a long time, I found it terribly embarrassing to try to change in front of my friends.
lines.translation: 很长一段时间，我都觉得，在朋友面前试着改变自己，是件特别尴尬的事。

lines.text: Like, the biggest obstacle to changing myself was the people who knew me well.
lines.translation: 怎么说呢，真正让我难以改变的，反而是那些很了解我的人。

lines.text: 'Cause I was so aware that they already had an existing impression of me, and I really didn't want to go against that and shock them in any way.
lines.translation: 因为我很清楚，他们心里早就有了一个固定的我。我真的不想打破那个印象，让他们觉得意外。

vocabulary.meaning: 特别让人尴尬；terribly 在这里只是加强语气。
做某事的障碍；这里的 to 是介词，后接 changing。
违背、与……不符；这里指不再符合朋友对自己的印象。

paragraphs.text: For a long time, I found it terribly embarrassing to try to change in front of my friends. Like, the biggest obstacle to changing myself was the people who knew me well. 'Cause I was so aware that they already had an existing impression of me, and I really didn't want to go against that and shock them in any way.

lines.text: It feels dangerous.
lines.translation: 这会让人觉得有点冒险。

lines.text: And the danger doesn't totally come from the change itself.
lines.translation: 而这种不安并不完全来自改变本身。

lines.text: It sometimes comes from anticipating how familiar people will react to it.
lines.translation: 有时，它来自你提前想象：熟悉你的人会怎么反应？

vocabulary.meaning: 预料、预想；这里指还没发生，就已经开始想象别人会怎么反应。
对……作出反应；to 后面接引起反应的事。

paragraphs.text: It feels dangerous. And the danger doesn't totally come from the change itself. It sometimes comes from anticipating how familiar people will react to it.

lines.text: Take taking photos, for example.
lines.translation: 就拿拍照来说吧。

lines.text: I didn't used to know how to pose or what facial expression to make when someone pointed a camera at me.
lines.translation: 以前只要有人把镜头对着我，我就不知道该摆什么姿势，也不知道脸上该是什么表情。

lines.text: But I actually wanted to be more expressive and playful in pictures.
lines.translation: 其实我很想在照片里表现得更有意思、更放得开一点。

vocabulary.meaning: 摆姿势，常指面对镜头时摆出某个动作。
表情或动作丰富，能把情绪表现出来。
俏皮、爱玩；这里指拍照时愿意放开一点、尝试好玩的表情。

paragraphs.text: Take taking photos, for example. I didn't used to know how to pose or what facial expression to make when someone pointed a camera at me. But I actually wanted to be more expressive and playful in pictures.

lines.text: The problem for me was that some of my friends were already used to seeing me as this person who never knew what to do in front of cameras.
lines.translation: 问题是，有些朋友已经习惯把我看成那个一面对镜头就手足无措的人。

lines.text: So whenever I tried to pose more confidently or deliberately, I was just so very conscious of how they might think of this new me.
lines.translation: 所以每次我想摆得更自信一点，或有意识地摆个姿势，我都会特别在意：他们会怎么看这个不一样的我？

vocabulary.meaning: 已经习惯看到……。和 used to do（过去常做）不是同一个结构。
有意识地、有意地；这里指主动选择一个姿势，而不是随便站着。
意识到、留意到；这里指很在意别人怎么看。

paragraphs.text: The problem for me was that some of my friends were already used to seeing me as this person who never knew what to do in front of cameras. So whenever I tried to pose more confidently or deliberately, I was just so very conscious of how they might think of this new me.

lines.text: It felt like playing a completely different character in front of an audience who knew exactly what the original character was supposed to be.
lines.translation: 那感觉就像当着一群观众的面，突然演起了一个完全不同的角色，可他们明明都知道原来的角色应该是什么样。

lines.text: Of course, a lot of the time I was just overthinking, but I couldn't help it.
lines.translation: 当然，很多时候其实是我想多了，但我就是忍不住。

vocabulary.meaning: 按预期应该是什么样；这里指观众心里熟悉的那个角色设定。
想得太多，把一件事反复琢磨到让自己更紧张。
忍不住，没办法不这么做；这里的 it 指反复多想。

paragraphs.text: It felt like playing a completely different character in front of an audience who knew exactly what the original character was supposed to be. Of course, a lot of the time I was just overthinking, but I couldn't help it.

edits.before: I didn't used to know how to pose
edits.after: I didn't use to know how to pose
edits.explanation: 保留原转写；规范写法中 didn't 已经表示过去，后面用 use。这里是「以前不会」，不是「不习惯」。

edits.before: how they might think of this new me
edits.after: what they might think of this new me
edits.explanation: 想表达「他们对新的我有什么看法」，通常说 what they might think of me；也可说 how they might see me。

articles.voice: 美式女声 · SLT 合成朗读

articles.title: Don’t Make Someone Else’s Ceiling Your Own
articles.subtitle: 别把别人的上限当成自己的｜根据用户整理的视频文字；仅调整标点，未核对原视频音轨。

lines.text: I'm not sure if you know about this, but when you become too fixated on one person, you're actually capping your potential to their level.
lines.translation: 我不知道你有没有意识到：当你把太多注意力放在一个人身上时，你其实是在拿对方的水平给自己的潜力设限。

lines.text: Because you can only see as far as that person has gone, and in a way, you're sort of setting their ceiling as yours.
lines.translation: 因为你的视野也只到对方走到的地方。某种意义上，你等于把对方的上限当成了自己的上限。

vocabulary.meaning: 对……过度关注，心思一直卡在上面。
给自己的潜力设上限；cap 在这里是动词「限制」。
天花板；这里比喻一个人能达到的上限。
从某个角度来看；某种意义上。

paragraphs.text: I'm not sure if you know about this, but when you become too fixated on one person, you're actually capping your potential to their level. Because you can only see as far as that person has gone, and in a way, you're sort of setting their ceiling as yours.

lines.text: And I think it's a very dangerous territory because it applies to both romantic relationships as well as those subtle unspoken rivalries between you and other people.
lines.translation: 我觉得这种心态很容易让人陷进去。它不只会出现在恋爱里，也会出现在你和别人那种没说出口、却暗暗较劲的关系里。

vocabulary.meaning: 有风险的处境或话题，这里不是指危险地带。
适用于……；在……情形下也成立。
细微的、不易察觉的；b 不发音。
没说出口的竞争；两个人暗暗较劲。

paragraphs.text: And I think it's a very dangerous territory because it applies to both romantic relationships as well as those subtle unspoken rivalries between you and other people.

lines.text: Sometimes you are just too close to it, and maybe it's time to zoom out.
lines.translation: 有时你只是离这件事太近，看不见全局。也许该退一步，把视野拉远。

vocabulary.meaning: 离这件事太近；这里指身在其中，难以看清全局。
把镜头拉远；比喻退一步看大局。

paragraphs.text: Sometimes you are just too close to it, and maybe it's time to zoom out.

edits.before: it applies to both romantic relationships as well as those subtle unspoken rivalries
edits.after: it applies to both romantic relationships and those subtle unspoken rivalries
edits.explanation: 原音转写保留。自己写或说时用 both A and B，或单用 A as well as B，不要混用。

edits.before: you're actually capping your potential to their level
edits.after: you're actually limiting yourself to what they've achieved
edits.explanation: 原句能听懂。更口语的改述强调「拿对方已经达到的成就给自己设上限」。

articles.title: Finding My Own Taste
articles.subtitle: 从博主分享和电影推荐谈起，思考为什么自己难以说清喜好，以及如何关注真实的个人感受。

paragraphs.text: Okay, last night my friend and I were talking about something really interesting and confusing at the same time.

lines.text: Okay, last night my friend and I were talking about something really interesting and confusing at the same time.
lines.translation: 昨晚，我和朋友聊起了一件既有趣又让人困惑的事。

paragraphs.text: We noticed that some people seem to have an unbelievably detailed sense of their own preferences and everyday experiences, but we just don't seem to have that.

vocabulary.meaning: 令人难以置信地；这里强调程度很高

lines.text: We noticed that some people seem to have an unbelievably detailed sense of their own preferences and everyday experiences, but we just don't seem to have that.
lines.translation: 我们发现，有些人似乎对自己的喜好和日常体验有着极其细致的感知，但我们好像没有。

paragraphs.text: For example, there's this vlogger my friend follows. When she does a room tour, she can talk about almost every little detail in her house, like why she puts a particular piece of furniture there, how she uses it, and what she likes about it.

lines.text: For example, there's this vlogger my friend follows.
lines.translation: 比如，我朋友关注的一位视频博主。

lines.text: When she does a room tour, she can talk about almost every little detail in her house, like why she puts a particular piece of furniture there, how she uses it, and what she likes about it.
lines.translation: 她介绍自己的房间时，几乎能说出家里每一个小细节：为什么把某件家具放在那里、怎么使用它，以及喜欢它的哪些地方。

paragraphs.text: And the same goes for a beauty influencer I watch. She can just take out an ordinary skincare product and somehow have so much to say about its packaging, how she uses it, and how this little thing fits—or doesn't fit—into her daily life.

vocabulary.meaning: 社交媒体上有影响力的人；博主

lines.text: And the same goes for a beauty influencer I watch.
lines.translation: 我关注的一位美妆博主也是如此。

lines.text: She can just take out an ordinary skincare product and somehow have so much to say about its packaging, how she uses it, and how this little thing fits—or doesn't fit—into her daily life.
lines.translation: 她随手拿出一件普通护肤品，就能谈很多：它的包装、用法，以及这件小东西如何融入——或不适合——她的日常生活。

paragraphs.text: And think about some celebrity interviews where actors are asked to name, like, five favorite movies. I remember seeing the Stranger Things cast being asked this kind of question, and everybody just seemed to have a very personal, well-defined list ready to go.

vocabulary.meaning: 一部影视作品的全体演员
清晰明确的；这里指喜好很明确

lines.text: And think about some celebrity interviews where actors are asked to name, like, five favorite movies.
lines.translation: 再想想一些明星访谈，演员会被问到最喜欢的五部电影之类的问题。

lines.text: I remember seeing the Stranger Things cast being asked this kind of question, and everybody just seemed to have a very personal, well-defined list ready to go.
lines.translation: 我记得看过《怪奇物语》的演员们回答这类问题，每个人似乎都早有一份很个人化、很明确的片单。

paragraphs.text: And this is just one example. There are countless moments like this.

lines.text: And this is just one example.
lines.translation: 这还只是一个例子。

lines.text: There are countless moments like this.
lines.translation: 类似的时刻还有无数个。

paragraphs.text: I also watch plenty of movies, but if I were in their shoes, I honestly wouldn't know what to say.

vocabulary.meaning: 处在他们的位置；设身处地

lines.text: I also watch plenty of movies, but if I were in their shoes, I honestly wouldn't know what to say.
lines.translation: 我也看很多电影，但如果换作是我，说实话，我都不知道该说些什么。

paragraphs.text: I mean, I can evaluate things from the outside. I remember writing film reviews for homework when I was a kid. But back then, I was never telling the truth, because nobody asked me to. I just had to write down something that sounded right, that met a certain standard, to get the assignment done and hopefully get a great mark.

lines.text: I mean, I can evaluate things from the outside.
lines.translation: 我是说，我能够从外部标准来评价事物。

lines.text: I remember writing film reviews for homework when I was a kid.
lines.translation: 我记得小时候写过作为作业的影评。

lines.text: But back then, I was never telling the truth, because nobody asked me to.
lines.translation: 但那时我从来没表达过真实想法，因为没人要求我这样做。

lines.text: I just had to write down something that sounded right, that met a certain standard, to get the assignment done and hopefully get a great mark.
lines.translation: 我只需要写些听起来正确、符合某种标准的话，把作业完成，并希望拿到好成绩。

paragraphs.text: I hardly ever ask myself about my personal preferences, whether it's when I'm watching movies or just going about my everyday life.

vocabulary.meaning: 这里指照常进行、过着（日常生活）

lines.text: I hardly ever ask myself about my personal preferences, whether it's when I'm watching movies or just going about my everyday life.
lines.translation: 无论是看电影，还是过着日常生活，我几乎从不问自己真正的喜好是什么。

paragraphs.text: So if you asked me for a movie recommendation, I'd probably end up naming a bunch of universally acclaimed classics rather than something that genuinely reflects my personal taste.

lines.text: So if you asked me for a movie recommendation, I'd probably end up naming a bunch of universally acclaimed classics rather than something that genuinely reflects my personal taste.
lines.translation: 所以，如果你让我推荐电影，我多半会列出一堆广受赞誉的经典，而不是那些真正体现我个人品味的作品。

edits.explanation: 去掉口语中重复的主语，让句子更顺畅。

edits.after: its packaging, how she uses it
edits.explanation: 谈产品包装用 packaging 更自然；使用方式改为更口语的表达。

edits.after: if I were in their shoes
edits.explanation: 更自然地表达‘如果换作是我’。

edits.after: I just had to write down
edits.explanation: 与过去的作业经历保持一致，保留为了达标而写的原意。

edits.before: no matter when it comes to
edits.after: whether it's when I'm watching movies or just going about my everyday life
edits.explanation: 修正搭配，明确电影和日常生活两个情境。

edits.after: for a movie recommendation / genuinely reflects
edits.explanation: 补充冠词，并修正主谓一致。

articles.title: Performing in Real Time
articles.subtitle: 为什么即时表现让人紧张，而反复修改让人安心？从唱歌、考试和写作谈起，思考如何练习临场应对。
articles.sourceNote: 根据提供的英文转写校对，保留口语中的停顿；未核对原视频。

paragraphs.text: I guess people who don't have much experience with real-time competition tend to get nervous pretty easily. Like me, I struggle to stay calm under pressure.

lines.text: I guess people who don't have much experience with real-time competition tend to get nervous pretty easily.
lines.translation: 我想，那些没怎么经历过即时竞争的人，往往很容易紧张。

lines.text: Like me, I struggle to stay calm under pressure.
lines.translation: 就像我，在压力下很难保持冷静。

paragraphs.text: When it comes to things that happen in real time... By that, I mean things like singing. You've only got maybe three minutes, and every second counts.

vocabulary.meaning: 每一秒都很重要；分秒必争

lines.text: When it comes to things that happen in real time...
lines.translation: 说到那些需要当场应对的事情……

lines.text: By that, I mean things like singing.
lines.translation: 我指的是唱歌这类事。

lines.text: You've only got maybe three minutes, and every second counts.
lines.translation: 你可能只有三分钟，每一秒都很重要。

paragraphs.text: Whatever you deliver in that moment is what people get. There's no going back to change your work or fix things afterward.

vocabulary.meaning: 这里指呈现、展现（当场的表现）

lines.text: Whatever you deliver in that moment is what people get.
lines.translation: 你在那一刻呈现什么，别人接收到的就是什么。

lines.text: There's no going back to change your work or fix things afterward.
lines.translation: 事后无法回头修改作品或弥补问题。

paragraphs.text: And I'm a total mess when it comes to things like that.

vocabulary.meaning: 一团糟；这里形容自己紧张失措

lines.text: And I'm a total mess when it comes to things like that.
lines.translation: 一碰上这样的事，我就会彻底乱了阵脚。

paragraphs.text: But I'm very comfortable with things that allow me to double-check, review, and revise.

lines.text: But I'm very comfortable with things that allow me to double-check, review, and revise.
lines.translation: 但如果事情允许我反复检查、回顾和修改，我就会很自在。

paragraphs.text: Like taking an exam or writing a paper. With a paper, I can always go through my work time and time again before handing it in and having to face the result.

lines.text: Like taking an exam or writing a paper.
lines.translation: 比如参加考试或写论文。

lines.text: With a paper, I can always go through my work time and time again before handing it in and having to face the result.
lines.translation: 写论文时，在提交并面对结果之前，我总能一遍又一遍地检查自己的内容。

paragraphs.text: I love that feeling of having control over the whole process.

lines.text: I love that feeling of having control over the whole process.
lines.translation: 我喜欢那种能够掌控整个过程的感觉。

paragraphs.text: So I guess I should try more... or just put myself in more situations where I have to respond and perform in real time.

lines.text: So I guess I should try more... or just put myself in more situations where I have to respond and perform in real time.
lines.translation: 所以，我想我应该多尝试……或者多让自己置身于必须即时回应、当场表现的情境中。

paragraphs.text: Just to develop that skill.

lines.text: Just to develop that skill.
lines.translation: 就是为了培养这项能力。

edits.before: have a pretty weak nerve / I have a very weak mentality
edits.after: get nervous pretty easily / I struggle to stay calm under pressure
edits.explanation: 改为自然表达‘容易紧张、在压力下难以保持冷静’，保留原来的自我描述。

edits.before: There's no going back. Changing your work or fixing things after...
edits.after: There's no going back to change your work or fix things afterward.
edits.explanation: 连接相邻片段，说明即时表现后无法回头修改；用 afterward 表达‘事后’。

edits.before: A paper, I can always ... Before handing in
edits.after: With a paper, I can always ... before handing it in
edits.explanation: 用 With a paper 引出写作情境，并补上 hand in 的宾语 it。

edits.before: Just in order to train the skill.
edits.explanation: 培养技能通常说 develop a skill；保留为了练习临场应对而尝试的原意。
